text: Select: [drug.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, drug.pref_name AS drug_name, indication.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading, indication.efo_term AS indication_efo_term, indication.efo_id AS indication_efo_id, indication.mesh_id AS indication_mesh_id, indication.max_phase_for_ind AS indication_max_phase] Source: [molecule_dictionary, drug_indication] Join: [molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno] Filter: [drug.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND drug.oral = 1 AND indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%'] Sort: [indication.mesh_heading ASC] Limit: [100]
